description: A stable fingerprint of a page that ignores noise like timestamps and session ids, plus a verdict on whether it changed since a previous fingerprint. Use this to watch a page without storing or diffing its HTML yourself. Costs $0.015 per call, paid in USDC on Base.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope the fingerprint to one region.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to process.

name: farm_fingerprint
title: Page fingerprint / change detection
